title: Menang Pertama
notes: Source of truth for Episode 7. Matchday 2 vs Otai Kampung FC: menang 1-0, first win bonus + KEK MAJU gate boost drops the debt RM331,500 -> RM316,500. Ends with the standard 72-frame Buluh FC / EPISOD 7 card. No CTAs.

scenes.name: Act 1 — Otai Mind Games
scenes.visual: Frame 0: a ball whizzes past the post and clangs the crossbar. Pak Din jogs at walking pace past the Buluh FC press, flashing a cheeky grin and needling Azam about his RM5 salary.
scenes.sfx: crossbar clang (bell + kick) at frame 0; slow sneakers; light crowd murmur.
scenes.bgm: Warm-but-tense match bed, ducked under dialogue.

events.note: Azam -> Pak Din reading the pitch.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Otai Kampung FC. Lambat jalan, tapi mulut lebih laju dari kaki.
lines.translation: Otai Kampung FC. Slow on the feet, faster with the mouth.

lines.speaker: PAK DIN
lines.text: Gaji lima ringgit? Anak muda, aku boleh bayar seminggu dengan duit poket.
lines.translation: Five ringgit salary? Kid, I can pay you a week's wage from my pocket money.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Boleh la. Tarikh gaji nanti saya panjang tangan sikit.
lines.translation: Sure. On payday I might get a little grabby.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dia jalan perlahan. Tapi matanya baca padang macam main catur.
lines.translation: He walks slowly. But he reads the pitch like a chessboard.

scenes.name: Act 2 — First Goal
scenes.visual: High press from the touchline; Azam reads Pak Din's cheeky pass, intercepts and launches Farid, who blasts in Buluh FC's first Divisyen 5 goal. MatchHUD ticks 1-0.
scenes.sfx: coach shout; boot-on-ball; crowd swell; net swish on the goal.
scenes.bgm: Match bed lifting into the counter-attack.

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.text: Tinggi! Press dari depan! Jangan tunggu dia bagi pass!
lines.translation: Push up! Press from the front! Don't wait for his pass!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Pak Din bagi pass kecil — Azam baca, dan potong.
lines.translation: Pak Din slips a little pass — Azam reads it and cuts it out.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Satu sentuhan. Satu sorakan. Gol pertama Buluh FC musim ni!
lines.translation: One touch. One roar. Buluh FC's first goal of the season!

scenes.name: Act 3 — Fulltime Payout
scenes.visual: Fulltime whistle. The KEK MAJU ad-board glows behind the celebration; Bos pockets the first win bonus and local gate receipts. DebtTickerHUD rolls GREEN to RM316,500.
scenes.sfx: fulltime whistle; crowd cheer; coin/bell sting on the debt landing.
scenes.bgm: Warm triumph bed under the payout.

events.note: Celebration -> Bos at the KEK MAJU board.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Whistle panjang. KEK MAJU berdiri depan, papan iklan dia nampak lebih terang.
lines.translation: Fulltime. KEK MAJU is front and centre, and her ad-board never looked brighter.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Lima belas ribu masuk. Tiket, bukan duit syiling.
lines.translation: Fifteen grand in. Ticket money, not pocket change.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Hutang turun. Tiga ratus tiga puluh satu ke tiga ratus enam belas.
lines.translation: The debt drops. Three-thirty-one to three-sixteen.

scenes.name: Buluh FC Series Outro
scenes.visual: Standard black Buluh FC / EPISOD 7 card. No CTA.
